refine_summary: Encountered three main issues: 1) Used deprecated driver.TDVPSchmitt instead of nk.experimental.TDVP, 2) TDVP no longer accepts 'dt' parameter directly, 3) integrator module not found in netket.experimental. Made two fixes: first changed to TDVP with dt parameter, then attempted to use integrator with RK4, but failed due to incorrect module path. Still failing after 2 iterations. The correct approach likely requires using the proper integrator module path or a different time-stepping configuration.
